title: yardstick-studies: a verifiable-study kernel for LLM-in-the-loop research
description: Reference implementation of the verifiable-study standard: fenced data with logged reads, generated registration facts, a gate board computed from artifacts, strict results schemas, paired-equivalence and paired-comparison templates, an LLM-study kit (generation archive with content hashes, request-template hashing, pinned-model retirement check, generator-drift check, spend ledger), and replay attestations.
